query: Super Micro revenue guidance next quarter fiscal year
normalized: fiscal guidance micro next quarter revenue super year

output.content:
Super Micro Computer’s latest **next-quarter revenue guidance** is **$14.5 billion–$15.5 billion** for fiscal Q1 2027, which ends September 30, 2026. [[1]] 

For the full fiscal year 2027, Supermicro guided to **$65.0 billion–$72.0 billion** of net sales. [[1]] 

The guidance was issued with its FY2026 results on August 11, 2026; FY2026 revenue was $39.1 billion. [[1]]

sources.title: Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Supermicro Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
